_comment: OEM leak-surface manifest (D-08). Grep-generated over LeavePilot / Leave Pilot / TimeOff / timeoff / timeoff.management BEFORE the test was written (re-ran the grep at authoring time: every rendered surface is dynamic via branding.get(); only one actionable hardcoded rendered literal remained — the SSO client_id placeholder, recorded below in hardcoded[]). Consumed directly by t/unit/oem_no_vendor_leak.js, which ITERATES dynamic[] and renders each surface under a sentinel custom brand + oemActive:true, asserting BOTH custom-PRESENT and vendor-ABSENT. CI-gated every PR via .github/workflows/core-ci.yml (npm run test:coverage -> nyc mocha --recursive t/unit). See docs/oem-leak-surfaces.md for the human-readable pointer.

dynamic.renders: favicons, apple-touch-icon, manifest link, page <title> (title falls back to {{brand_name}} when no page title is set)
dynamic.consumes: branding.get() (faviconUrl, faviconPng32Url, faviconPng16Url, appIconUrl, appleTouchIconUrl, manifestUrl) + {{brand_name}} helper -> branding.get().name (lib/view/helpers.js)

dynamic.renders: navbar brand link (aria-label + logo alt + visible text)
email From: address across 13 send sites
admin license-status line / upsell section (SUPPRESSED under oemActive — renders nothing)
dynamic.consumes: branding.oemActive (the {{#unless branding.oemActive}} gate; also reads branding.name via the {{brand}} placeholder)

excluded.reason: the brand layer / D-05 gate itself; DEFAULT_BRANDING constants (L7-21) are the fallback-of-record shown when OEM is NOT active OR the brand config is INCOMPLETE (the CR-01 atomic rule: every vendor-identity field must be rebranded or the WHOLE custom brand is rejected to the default, so no operator-value/vendor-default hybrid can render); the rejection path is pinned by the t/unit/oem_gate.js CR-01 matrix; getEmailFrom() is the email surface's source (already listed in dynamic[] as lib/email.js), not a separate rendered surface

the render MECHANISM for the .hbs dynamic surfaces ({{brand_name}} helper -> branding.get().name; t('brand.name'/'brand.nameLower') interception -> branding.get().name); it is how surfaces main.hbs/header.hbs/footer.hbs reach the brand, not a separate rendered surface itself
SSR wiring that attaches branding.get() to res.locals for the /settings/general/ license-status line; it FEEDS settings_company_license.hbs (listed in dynamic[]), not a separate rendered surface
host-comparison logic ('app.timeoff') that decides url_to_the_site_root for anonymous sessions; returns '/' for non-app.timeoff hosts so no vendor link renders — logic-only, never displayed

JS runtime namespace window.timeoff / id="timeoff-config" / timeoff-theme localStorage (global.js, config_boot.js, theme_boot.js, leave_forecast.js, reminder_schedules.js); D-11 one-way scope decision: devtools-observable code identifier, NOT rendered text — OUT of leak scope. Renaming the namespace is a separate large phase (much client JS references it)
